description: Real-story goals for the fusion planning benchmark (FU1). Goal from story BOD-417 (doctor-capability-gateway-probe), merged in PR #1191.

goals.goal:
doctor-capability-gateway-probe: verdict doctor reports gateway.inventory and gateway.execute as DEGRADED with health null on a machine whose OmniRoute gateway is healthy. Cause: verdict/capability_bootstrap.py doctor_capability_report() runs run_bootstrap() with no probe_gateway, so discover_providers() falls back to _default_gateway_probe, a setup plan-mode stub that never probes and always returns health_ok False ("endpoint configured but not live-certified"). Doctor already has a real authenticated gateway probe (verdict/doctor_diagnostics.py _cli_bootstrap() plus _gateway_probe_for(bootstrap), used by _doctor_gateway_lifecycle). Make the capability report use that real probe result.
Acceptance: (1) doctor_capability_report gains a keyword argument probe_gateway: GatewayProbe | None = None that is passed through to run_bootstrap(probe_gateway=...); default behaviour unchanged. (2) verdict/doctor_diagnostics.py gains def _doctor_capability_gateway_probe() -> Callable[[str], dict[str, Any]] returning a probe: for provider_id "gateway.omniroute" it resolves bootstrap = _cli_bootstrap(), calls health = _gateway_probe_for(bootstrap)(bootstrap.gateway_url) and returns {"reachable": health.reachable, "health_ok": health.reachable, "reason": health.detail or ("gateway healthy" if reachable else "gateway did not answer"), "endpoint": redact_url(bootstrap.gateway_url)} (redact_url from verdict.provider_bootstrap); a BootstrapError (verdict.provider_bootstrap) or a missing gateway_url gives {"reachable": False, "health_ok": False, "reason": <reason_code or "no gateway url">}; any other provider_id gives {"reachable": False, "health_ok": False, "reason": "not probed by doctor"}. Never print or return the API key. (3) _collect_doctor_diagnostics calls doctor_capability_report(probe_gateway=_doctor_capability_gateway_probe()). (4) New tests in tests/test_doctor_capability_gateway_probe.py, no network: a healthy fake probe makes gateway.inventory and gateway.execute "covered" with selected_provider_id "gateway.omniroute" and health "healthy"; an unreachable fake keeps them not covered; the doctor probe maps a reachable GatewayHealth to health_ok True, an unreachable one to health_ok False with its detail as reason, a BootstrapError to its reason_code, and another provider id to "not probed by doctor" (monkeypatch verdict.doctor_diagnostics._cli_bootstrap and _gateway_probe_for). (5) An OpenSpec change openspec/changes/doctor-capability-gateway-probe that passes `openspec validate doctor-capability-gateway-probe --strict`.
Test command: python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_doctor_capability_gateway_probe.py tests/test_capability_bootstrap.py tests/test_doctor_gateway_probe_key.py
goals.constraints:
- Use exactly two implement nodes plus one integrate node. Node "probe_fix" owns verdict/capability_bootstrap.py, verdict/doctor_diagnostics.py and tests/test_doctor_capability_gateway_probe.py; verification_command ["python","-m","pytest","-q","-p","no:cacheprovider","tests/test_doctor_capability_gateway_probe.py","tests/test_capability_bootstrap.py"]. Node "probe_spec" owns only openspec/changes/doctor-capability-gateway-probe/ files .openspec.yaml (`schema: verdict-change-v1`), proposal.md (## Why, ## What Changes, ## Capabilities with ### New Capabilities `doctor-capability-gateway-probe` and empty ### Modified Capabilities, ## Impact, ## Acceptance criteria, evidence bullets labelled KNOWN:, INFERRED:, NOT AVAILABLE:), design.md (## Context, ## Goals / Non-Goals, ## Decisions, ## Risks / Trade-offs, and non-empty ### Security / trust implications, ### Routing / context / memory implications, ### Migration / rollback, ### ADR impact), specs/doctor-capability-gateway-probe/spec.md ('# Spec Delta', '## Purpose', '## ADDED Requirements'; each '### Requirement: <short name>' header has NO SHALL, the very next line is one sentence containing SHALL, then a '#### Scenario:' with '- **WHEN**'/'- **THEN**'), tasks.md (first line '# Tasks'; groups '## 1. probe_fix', '## 2. probe_spec', each with lines 'Owner: <node>' and 'Verify: <command>'; every task '- [x]'); verification_command ["sh","-c","openspec validate doctor-capability-gateway-probe --strict --no-interactive && python verdict/openspec_vendor/validate_openspec_change.py openspec/changes/doctor-capability-gateway-probe && ! grep -q -- '- \\[ \\]' openspec/changes/doctor-capability-gateway-probe/tasks.md"].
- The integrate node depends on both and runs ["python","-m","pytest","-q","-p","no:cacheprovider","tests/test_doctor_capability_gateway_probe.py","tests/test_capability_bootstrap.py","tests/test_doctor_gateway_probe_key.py","tests/test_actions_boundary.py"].
- Edit only the owned files, with minimal SEARCH/REPLACE hunks. Do not reformat or rewrite unrelated code. Keep ruff clean, line length 100, full type hints (mypy --strict). Imports inside the new function are fine (doctor_diagnostics already imports lazily).
- Tests must not touch the network or the real ~/.verdict: pass fake probes, monkeypatch verdict.doctor_diagnostics._cli_bootstrap and verdict.doctor_diagnostics._gateway_probe_for, and build GatewayHealth from verdict.gateway_lifecycle (GatewayHealth(reachable=..., responded=..., detail=...)). For BootstrapError in tests, construct it with at least one diagnostic (the empty-tuple form is rejected at runtime): `BootstrapError("reason_code", (BootstrapDiagnostic(code="reason_code", diagnostic_class="gateway_health", field="gateway_url", detail="probe failed", remediation="check gateway url"),))` — import both BootstrapError and BootstrapDiagnostic from verdict.provider_bootstrap. DiagnosticClass is Literal["configuration", "gateway_health", "model_eligibility"], not an enum — use the string directly, never DiagnosticClass.xxx notation.
- Never write host paths, URLs with credentials, or keys into any file.
- Every node's required_capabilities MUST be exactly ["tools"] (never "structured_output" or "reasoning"); set reasoning false and coding true on the two implement nodes, coding false on integrate. min_context_tokens 32000.
- Write each node objective self-contained, with every concrete instruction it needs copied from the goal (function names, signatures, return dicts, test names), so a worker never needs files it does not own.
- probe_spec objective must say plainly: this node writes ONLY the five OpenSpec Markdown/YAML files; the code change is done by the separate probe_fix node, so do not block because code files are not owned. Describe the behaviour from the goal in the proposal and spec.
